[center][b][size=6][color=#00ffff]Install[/color][/size]
[/b][/center]



[b][u][color=#00ff00][size=4]> For CP version:[/size][/color]

[/u][/b][size=3]1. Dowload the file, unzip and drag it to your mods folder[/size]

[size=3]2. This mod requires [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url][size=3] to be running at the same time.[/size]

[size=3]   Please note that the event and config versions are mutually exclusive，so only enable one of them.[/size]

[size=3]3.  In-game, talk to the Wizard and press[b][color=#ffff00] [ P ] [/color][/b]until it switches to HDP, then press[b][color=#ffff00] [ O ][/color][/b] to lock it in.[/size]



[b][u][color=#00ff00][size=4]> For Portraiture Plus version:[/size][/color][/u][/b]

[size=3]1. Make sure you have [/size][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url][/b][size=3], [/size][b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/b][size=3], and [/size][b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]RRRR[/url][/b][size=3] before downloading this mod.[/size]


[size=3]2. After downloading the PortraiturePlus version, unzip the file, and you’ll find mutiple folders inside the Wizard folder. Pick the one you like, then copy and paste it into this folder: [/size]

[size=3]    [/size][b][color=#f9cb9c]Mods > Portraiture> Portraits > [CP] Wizard Portraits RRRR[32][/color][/b]

[size=3]    ( You can check the IMAGES tab for an example of the correct folder path )[/size]


[b][color=#b6d7a8]3. Want to mix the long hair and mid hair versions?[/color]

[/b][size=3]Just copy the individual image you like and replace the one in the [CP] Wizard Portraits RRRR[32] folder.[/size]

[size=3]Since PortraiturePlus works by reading image names, you can even rename an outfit from Season A to Season B. It’ll still work fine :D[/size]

[size=3]>>  For more naming rules, check the PortraiturePlus Description page.[/size]


[size=3]4. Morgan and Camilla Portraits go here: [/size][b][color=#f9cb9c]Mods > Portraiture > Portraits[/color][/b]

[size=3]    Morgan Sprites should be replaced here: [/size][color=#f9cb9c][b]Mods > Stardew Valley Expanded > [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded > assets > CharacterFiles >     OverworldSprites > Morgan[/b][/color]


[size=3]5. That's it, enjoy! <3       [/size]

[size=3]    If you don't see portraits in the game, press [/size][b][color=#ffff00][ P ][/color][/b][size=3], then press [/size][b][color=#ffff00][ O ][/color][/b][size=3] to fix it![/size]
[center]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38449/38449-1760298918-142504190.png[/img][/center]


[left][size=3][b][u][u][color=#00ff00]>  如果使用CP版本，请看以下安装方式：[/color][/u][/u][/b][/size][/left]
[size=3]

1. 下载文件并解压，拖拽到mods文件夹里

2. 在运行此模组时请保证同时运行[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url]中的任一版本，注意此时event和config版本不能同时运行[/size]

[size=3]3. 进入游戏，在与法师对话时按[b][color=#ffff00]P[/color][/b]切换到HDP为止，再按[b][color=#ffff00]O[/color][/b]锁定[/size]



[size=3][b][u][color=#00ff00]> 如果使用plus版本，请看以下安装方式：[/color][/u][/b]

1. 确保你有PortraiturePlus, Portraiture, 以及 RRRR本体mod和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]RRRR季节性服装mod[/url]


2. 在下载PortraiturePlus版本后解压文件，法师文件夹里面有四个独立文件夹，分别对应法师的长发，妹妹头以及两个短发版本，选择你喜欢的版本复制粘贴到以下路径：[color=#f9cb9c][b]Mods > Portraiture> Portraits > [CP] Wizard Portraits RRRR[32]
[/b][/color]

[b][color=#b6d7a8]3. 是否可以混用长发和妹妹头版本？[/color][/b]

[b]可以，且修改起来非常简单灵活[/b]。

将你喜欢的单张图片复制粘贴，在[CP] Wizard Portraits RRRR[32]文件夹里替换原来的版本即可。

由于PortraiturePlus依靠识别图片名称工作，所以你甚至可以将A季节的服饰命名为B季节的服饰，这样做同样生效。

>>  更多命名规则请查看PortraiturePlus主页的Description。


4. 摩根和卡米拉肖像放置路径：[color=#f9cb9c][b]Mods > Portraiture> Portraits[/b][/color]

摩根行走图替换到以下路径：[color=#f9cb9c][b]Mods > Stardew Valley Expanded > [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded > assets > CharacterFiles > OverworldSprites > Morgan[/b][/color][/size]


[size=3]5. 进入游戏时，在和马格努斯对话时按[b][color=#ffff00]P[/color][/b]切换头像，接着按[b][color=#ffff00]O[/color][/b]锁定。[/size]
